info.title: pr-agentic-service executor gateway
info.description: executor /api/v1/<path> through pr-agentic-service as /api/v1/executor/<path>. Only these routes are open to API key callers; any other path is 404. See docs/gateway/executor-gateway.md.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Reads only. Master key: narrows the tenant-wide read to this user. Standard key: may only repeat X-User-Id (anything else is 403).

parameters.name: X-User-Id
parameters.description: Who calls (always required, every key kind). Our tenant: one of our active users (users.id or employee id). Another tenant: an SSO employee id (system accounts svc-...). Standard key: reads cover only this user's rows. Master key: reads cover the whole tenant. Writes are made for this user.

parameters.name: X-Project-Id
parameters.description: Optional project. Our tenant: a project the X-User-Id user is a member of (else 404). Another tenant: its own value, form-checked.

parameters.name: X-Session-Id
parameters.description: Optional session, needs X-Project-Id. Our tenant: a session of that project the user owns (else 404).

400.description: INVALID_IDENTITY: X-User-Id missing or malformed, X-Project-Id/X-Session-Id malformed, user_id query malformed

401.description: LOGIN_REQUIRED (no X-Api-Key) or INVALID_API_KEY (unknown or revoked key)

403.description: FORBIDDEN: unknown or inactive user, or a standard key naming another user in user_id

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the route is not open to key callers, the resource is not visible to the caller, or (our tenant) not a member of X-Project-Id

504.description: Relayed service did not answer in time

finalized_by.description: What ended the Execution: AGENT (finalize call), WAIT_TIMEOUT (no next MULTI Operation before the wait deadline) or MAX_RUNTIME (EXECUTION_MAX_RUNTIME_SECONDS reached). Null while open, for a SINGLE Execution that ended normally, and for cancellation.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Caller-owned identifiers such as batch or run IDs, stored as given and echoed in execution.completed. At most 32 keys matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$, 4096 serialized bytes.

FinalizedBy.title: FinalizedBy
FinalizedBy.description: What ended a MULTI Execution, or any Execution past its lifetime.
